name: sbom-generator
description: SBOM generation agent for Syft and CycloneDX.
author: Kdesk-Catalog

capabilities.name: Sbom Generator
capabilities.description: SBOM generation agent for Syft and CycloneDX.
commands: Syft dir: syft dir:. -o cyclonedx-json > sbom.json
Verify: cosign verify-attestation --key cosign.pub --type spdxjson nginx:latest
Sign: cosign attest --key cosign.key --predicate sbom.json --type spdxjson nginx:latest
examples: Syft dir: syft dir:. -o cyclonedx-json > sbom.json
Sign: cosign attest --key cosign.key --predicate sbom.json --type spdxjson nginx:latest

instructions:
